text:
Alex (CS): quick update on Stratus Horizon — they just spun up a second product team and want a pilot for site search + meeting-summary workflows :eyes:
Maria (AM): oh nice. did they indicate scale or QPS?
Alex (CS): initial ask is 50k queries/day with bursts to 150k during peak reports. also want sub-200ms p99 on search.
Jared (AE): that QPS + latency target will push them into Dedicated or reserved capacity unless we advise heavy caching/quantization.
Priya (Solutions): agree. we should propose a hybrid: hosted for summaries, Dedicated for search routes. can validate with a perf run.
Dan (SRE): what model family are they expecting? open models or want LlamaX-type performance?
Alex (CS): they're leaning open-source for cost control. mentioned Mistral-ish accuracy but open to recommendations.
Maria (AM): renewal touchpoint in 9 months — expansion now would materially change contract value. if we don't move fast this could be a renewal risk or competitor slip-in :confused:
Jared (AE): let's flag as 'high expansion potential' and prioritize enablement. I can do a pricing sketch.
Priya (Solutions): I'll draft a perf plan. need a baseline dataset and traffic profile from them. asked for sample logs yesterday, they should share by EOD.
Alex (CS): they sent a small corpus in S3 link: s3://stratus-horizon/prod-samples  — contains intent labels and meeting audio transcriptions.
Dan (SRE): for the perf run I'll need a short config. suggestion:
```
model: rdx-open-7b
quant: int8
batching: dynamic
warmup_keys: 100000
routes: search->dedicated, summaries->hosted
```
Priya (Solutions): perfect. can we run a quick smoke in staging next Tue? can we fit a 3h perf window?
Dan (SRE): I can carve capacity Tue 10-1 PT. need confirmation by EOD Mon.
Maria (AM): I'll coordinate with the customer and schedule the call. also capturing feedback: they called our docs on routing 'helpful but too generic' — they want a step-by-step for multi-route setups.
Alex (CS): noted. Priya — can you add a short how-to snippet for their engineers in the enablement deck?
Priya (Solutions): will do. I'll include runbook, curl example, and routing policy snippet.
Jared (AE): pricing note — if they commit to Dedicated for search we can include a 12mo uplift and 10% discount, elevates ARR and reduces renewal risk.
Maria (AM): good. action items: Jared pricing sketch, Priya perf plan + enablement deck, Dan reserve perf window, Alex confirm S3 access and that sample is representative. I'll chase customer for traffic profile.
Alex (CS): thanks — pinging @onboard-bot to create a tracking ticket.
onboard-bot: created ticket CH-4721 with assignees Jared, Priya, Dan, Alex. due 3d. :white_check_mark:
Jared (AE): thumbs up. if staging perf looks good we can propose a 90-day pilot on Dedicated with clear exit metrics.
Alex (CS): agreed. marking this as high-priority expansion motion.
Maria (AM): assigning follow-ups now. will update the account health dashboard after perf run. :thumbsup:
